segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers describe morning shine and buildup in pores, and most report the cleanser cuts oil and clears breakouts without over-stripping, though one notes it can still be drying if overused.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several say it leaves skin soft, smooth and even more moisturized than before, while others report it dries their skin out fast and one stopped after two days for that reason.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (oily T-zone, dry elsewhere) generally report balanced results with no pulling or excess oil, and some credit it with fading pigmentation and reducing pores.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the widest range of outcomes, from calmed, soft skin used sparingly to severe reactions including rashes, perioral dermatitis, stinging eyes and worsened breakouts.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their late 40s report brighter, softer skin, reduced fine lines and calmer rosacea with regular but limited use.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers describe smoother texture, faded fine lines around the forehead and eyes, and an overall younger-looking, brighter complexion with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Dryness is the most frequently reported side effect, especially with daily use or on already-dry skin; some reviewers pair it with heavy moisturizer and say results even out, while a few stopped use because dryness did not resolve.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin say it calms redness over time, but others report new redness, a facial rash, or a severe neck rash after use.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers describe irritation and a compromised barrier from overuse or from ingredients like SLS/alcohol, with one reporting weeks to recover; others report no irritation at all when following the recommended 2-3x/week frequency.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne scars and hyperpigmentation over weeks to months of consistent use, with no dissenting reports on this specific effect.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, fewer cystic and hormonal breakouts, and faster healing of active pimples; however several describe worse breakouts, including one severe reaction after only a few weeks of light use and one who saw no change in her non-acne skin issues.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the product controls oil and shine without stripping, though one long-time user notes it makes skin oilier later in the day as a normal response to cleansing.

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin so as recommended I only started gradually using this product 1-2 times per week. It left my skin feeling really clean so at first I thought it was great, until I realized that instead of cleansing my impurities it was causing me to breakout worse than ever before after only a few weeks of use (only a handful of times). I usually don't get acne aside from a few small blemishes now and then, but my face is currently covered in painful, embarrassing acne due to this product.

extraits.titre: Watch out for things with SLS
extraits.texte: Gave me perioral dermatitis because of the sodium lauryl sulfate. Do not recommend for people with sensitive skin! As soon as I stopped using it my skin cleared back up

I am 49 and have skin that gets mildly dry in winter. I have some sun spots and acne scars, rosacea on my nose, forehead frown lines, and general puffiness around my eyes. Otherwise I always get compliments on my skin and I think it does look younger than its age! I'm on a budget and trying to to keep a minimal routine, with products that are flexible for a 4-season climate. I was previously using a CeraVe cleanser that gets the job done, but leaves my skin a bit blah-looking and not feeling quite right texturally. I decided to splurge for my birthday and try this product. I LOVE that it has no noticeable scent! So far (winter) the cleanser is working great I and see no cons. I believe this product will also work well in summer's high humidity. It seems to be minimizing all of my skin issues listed above. I use a pea-sized amount of this cleanser at night and most mornings for clean, soft, bright skin. I apply it to damp skin with my fingers, then massage and remove with a soft wet wash cloth. At night I follow with either a retinol serum or The Ordinary Multi-Peptide serum, then MB's seaweed night cream. In the morning, I use this cleanser *only* if I did not use retinol the night before. On post-retinol mornings, I only wash with a warm wet cloth (I might also wipe nose and chin with a bit of toner). My morning products are MBs vitamin C serum and Hydro moisturizer (and I usually skip day moisturizer in summer, it just sweats off in the humidity). I have not experienced any

Yeah so DO NOT USE THIS EVERY DAY - your skin will be so peely, dry, and irritated; definitely abide by the directions. It doesn't foam as much as it lathers. It smells wonderful. AND it is definitely working for my hormonal acne (really it's working on all types of acne but I don't find a lot of products that really help the under-the-skin hormonal acne I get, and this is doing the trick!). It's a luxurious experience to use and I enjoy letting it sit on my skin and work some magic for a minute. YES IT IS DRYING but moisturize, moisturize, moisturize. Get a really good moisturizer and the fact that it is drying will be no problem (I use the Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion+ and a couple pumps of that works awesome). Seriously, this has been awesome over the last couple weeks. After using it, my pimples immediately start dying back. It's a miracle-worker for 16 dollars! I have combo skin - oily T-zone, pretty normal to dry everywhere else. Seriously a game changer.

My skin is super weird combination skin that can be very dry but also very oily at the same time. Because of this I have a very hard time exfoliating the dead skin off. This is the only product that has ever made that possible with no irritation. I use 3ish times a week and the philosophy cleanser the rest of the time and my skin loves it. I am at that awkward stage at 28 where I am battling the beginning of wrinkles and the end acne but for the past year or so that I've been using this my skin has been very happy in both regards!

extraits.titre: I don't often review products, but I will for this one!
extraits.texte: I used this for the first time when I bought the Anti-Aging Regimen Kit and I liked it but I wanted to try other cleansing products for my skin. After getting meh results, I decided to go back to this and try it again. Well, I can tell you that my face is SO HAPPY! I accidentally purchased 2 and I'm so glad I did. I put one in the shower to use every morning and one under my sink to use at night. My face is softer and smoother and my rosacea red cheeks are much calmer. I highly recommend this for anyone who needs help with wrinkles and redness!

I love this cleanser . I have dry ,older ,rosacea skin and this stuff is heavenly . I use it on my neck and arms too because those areas are red sometimes too and it definitely calms my skin down . I absolutely love this cleanser
